people.name: Vyacheslav Mikhaylovich Molotov (Skryabin)
people.nameZh: 維亞切斯拉夫·莫洛托夫

body.zh-Hant: LeMO 傳記記載，莫洛托夫本名斯克里亞賓，1890年3月9日生於維亞特卡省庫卡爾卡，父親經營商店。他1906年加入社會主義者並取黨名「莫洛托夫」（意為鐵錘），1909年因政治煽動被捕並流放沃洛格達省，1912年參與創辦黨機關報《真理報》並主持其編輯部，1916年逃出流放地返回彼得格勒。
body.en: The LeMO biography records that Molotov, born Skryabin on 9 March 1890 in Kukarka, Vyatka province, was a shopkeeper's son. He joined the socialists in 1906 and took the party name Molotov (hammer), was arrested for political agitation in 1909 and exiled to Vologda province, in 1912 co-founded the party organ Pravda and headed its editorial board, and in 1916 escaped exile and returned to Petrograd.

body.zh-Hant: LeMO 列出，1917至1920年他是彼得格勒、下諾夫哥羅德與頓巴斯等地區的領導幹部。1921年起他連續擔任聯共（布）中央委員直到1957年，並自1921至1926年任政治局候補委員，其後任政治局委員至1952年。1924至1930年他主持黨的農村工作委員會；1928年起兼任莫斯科市黨委書記。
body.en: LeMO lists him as a leading functionary in the Petrograd, Nizhny Novgorod and Donbass regions in 1917–1920. From 1921 he was an uninterrupted member of the Central Committee until 1957, and a candidate member of the Politburo in 1921–1926 and then a member until 1952. In 1924–1930 he headed the party committee for village work, and from 1928 he was secretary of the Moscow city party committee.

Nischni-Nowgorod und im Donbass

Kandidat (1921-1926) und anschließend Mitglied des Politbüros der KPdSU

ab 1928 Sekretär des Stadtparteikomitees Moskau

heading.zh-Hant: 政府首腦與外交人民委員（1930-1945）
heading.en: Head of government and foreign commissar, 1930–1945

body.zh-Hant: 據LeMO，莫洛托夫1930至1941年任人民委員會議主席，即蘇聯總理，並被視為史達林最親近的夥伴；1939至1949年任外交人民委員，1939年簽署對希特勒德國的互不侵犯條約，1941年簽署對日中立條約。1941年起史達林親任人民委員會議主席，莫洛托夫成為其副手；他也出席1943年德黑蘭、1945年雅爾達與波茨坦會議。GND 權威檔同樣載其1930至1941年為人民委員會議主席、1939至1949年為外交部長。
body.en: According to LeMO, Molotov chaired the Council of People's Commissars in 1930–1941, making him prime minister of the Soviet Union and Stalin's closest companion. He was People's Commissar for Foreign Affairs in 1939–1949, signing the non-aggression pact with Hitler's Germany in 1939 and the neutrality pact with Japan in 1941. From 1941 Stalin himself took the chairmanship of the Council and Molotov became his deputy; Molotov also attended the Tehran (1943), Yalta (1945) and Potsdam (1945) conferences. The GND authority record likewise gives him as chairman of the Council in 1930–1941 and foreign minister in 1939–1949.

Ministerpräsident der Sowjetunion

1939-1949 und 1953-1956 Außenminister

body.zh-Hant: LeMO 載，史達林死後莫洛托夫與馬林科夫、貝利亞組成三人核心，直到赫魯雪夫勝出。1953至1957年他先再任外交部長，1956年起轉任國家監察部長；1957年因圖謀推翻赫魯雪夫失敗，被指為「黨的敵人」，撤去全部黨政職務並調任駐烏蘭巴托大使。1984年恢復黨籍，1986年11月8日在莫斯科去世。
body.en: LeMO records that after Stalin's death Molotov formed a decisive triumvirate with Malenkov and Beria until Khrushchev prevailed. In 1953–1957 he was first foreign minister again and from 1956 minister of state control; in 1957, after a failed attempt to overthrow Khrushchev, he was declared a party enemy, stripped of all party and government offices and sent as ambassador to Ulan Bator. He was readmitted to the party in 1984 and died in Moscow on 8 November 1986.

heading.zh-Hant: 地方貴族與早期議員生涯
heading.en: Transylvanian noble and early parliamentary career

body.zh-Hant: 羅姆西奇的傳記指出，貝特倫伯爵1901年起成為議員；選上議員後，他的生活方式略有改變。該書把他1901至1918年的身分概括為帶有特蘭西瓦尼亞色彩的地區政治人物。他首次公開的政治演說被書中歸納為明確的農業主義綱領，但演說以對自由主義與自由黨的信念作結。
body.en: Romsics's biography says Count Bethlen became a deputy in 1901, and that being elected somewhat changed his way of life. The book characterises him in 1901–1918 as a regional politician with distinctive Transylvanian features. It summarises his first public political speech as an openly agrarian programme, though the speech closed with a profession of faith in liberalism and the Liberal Party.

citations.quote: Bár Bethlen 1901 után is maga felügyelte gazdaságait, képviselővé választása
némileg mégis megváltoztatta életformáját
1901 és 1918 között sajátos erdélyi jegyekkel rendelkező regionális politikus
Nyíltan és egyértelműen agrárius program
a szabadelvűség és a Sza- badelvű Párt melletti hitvallással zárta

body.zh-Hant: 同一著作概括，1918至1920年間貝特倫是反革命力量的主要組織者之一，並擔任匈牙利和平代表團的首席全權代表。書中寫到，五月底至八月初他是塞格德政府駐維也納的代表；和平代表團辭職後，他的首席全權代表任務隨之結束。
body.en: The same work summarises him in 1918–1920 as one of the chief organisers of the counter-revolutionary forces and as chief commissioner of the Hungarian peace delegation. It says that from the end of May to the beginning of August he acted as the Szeged government's representative in Vienna, and that his mandate as chief commissioner ended when the peace delegation resigned.

citations.quote: 1918-20-ban az ellenforradalmi erók egyik fő organizátora
a magyar békedelegáció fömegbízottja
május végétól augusztus elejéig Bethlen a szegedi kormány bécsi megbízottjaként
Ezzel Bethlen fómegbízotti megbízatása is megszúnt

heading.en: Prime minister and the Unity Party, 1921–1931

body.zh-Hant: 羅姆西奇稱他1921至1931年任匈牙利總理，是所謂霍爾蒂體制的建構者與鞏固者；GND 權威檔同樣記他1921至1931年任總理。書中說，他在擔任政府首腦期間同時是黨領袖。統一黨在隨後的國民議會選舉取得245席中的144席，而他恢復了二元帝國時期的公開投票制度。
body.en: Romsics says he was Hungary's prime minister in 1921–1931 and the creator and consolidator of the so-called Horthy system; the GND authority record likewise gives him as prime minister in 1921–1931. The book says he was both head of government and party leader during that time. In the following national assembly election the Unity Party won 144 of 245 seats, and he restored the open voting of the dualist era.

citations.quote: 1921-től 1931- ig Magyarország miniszterelnöke
az ún. Horthy-rendszer megalkotója és konszolidálója
Ministerpräsident von 1921-1931
Mindaddig, amíg kormányfő és pártvezér volt
Az Egységes Párt a nyílt szavazásos kerületekben
Ennek alapján a 245 mandátumból 144-et kapott
visszaállította a dualizmuskori nyílt szavazást

body.zh-Hant: 羅姆西奇說，他此後直到1945年是反納粹、親西方政治傾向的領袖人物。GND 權威檔記載他1946年10月5日去世。
body.en: Romsics says that afterwards, until 1945, he was the leading figure of the anti-Nazi and pro-Western political currents. The GND authority record gives his death as 5 October 1946.

body.zh-Hant: GND 權威檔將卡羅爾二世列為羅馬尼亞國王，記其生於1893年10月15日，1953年4月4日去世。
body.en: The GND authority record lists Carol II as King of Romania, born on 15 October 1893 and died on 4 April 1953.

citations.quote: König von Rumänien

body.zh-Hant: 卡羅爾二世是羅馬尼亞國王，在位自1930年至1940年，為斐迪南一世之子。他與平民出身的瑪格達·盧佩斯庫同居，並為她於1926年放棄王位與一切權利，讓給年幼的兒子米哈伊。1930年他意外返回羅馬尼亞。他廢黜年輕的國王，但獲得議會承認。
body.en: Carol II was King of Romania from 1930 to 1940 and a son of Ferdinand I. He lived with the commoner Magda Lupescu and, for her sake, renounced the throne and all rights in 1926 in favour of his minor son Michael. In 1930 he unexpectedly returned to Romania. He dethroned the young king but was recognised by Parliament.

body.zh-Hant: 民族農民黨的政府首腦馬紐徒勞地抗議他的返國。國王隨意罷免與任命政府及部長。最嚴重的衝突發生在國王與法西斯的鐵衛團之間。他的回應同樣殘酷，報復使至少同樣多的鐵衛團員喪命。1938年他廢除1923年憲法並通過新憲，同時禁止各政黨。民族復興陣線成為唯一獲准的政黨。
body.en: Iuliu Maniu, head of government from the National Peasant Party, protested his return in vain. The king dismissed and appointed governments and ministers at will. The most serious conflict was between the king and the fascist Iron Guard. His response was equally draconian, and his revenge cost at least as many Iron Guardists their lives. In 1938 he had the 1923 constitution abolished and a new one adopted, and he banned the political parties. The National Renaissance Front became the only permitted party.

body.zh-Hant: 外交上全面失敗，包括失去比薩拉比亞，在民間激起強烈憤怒。1940年9月，安東內斯庫將軍迫使卡羅爾退位，由兒子米哈伊繼位。卡羅爾獲准蒐集所有珍寶並運出國境。在蒂米什瓦拉車站，鐵衛團朝列車開槍，意圖殺死國王。他脫身後，日後定居於葡萄牙。這位流亡的國王於1953年死於葡萄牙的埃什托里爾。2003年他的靈柩被運回羅馬尼亞。
body.en: The total failure in foreign policy, including the loss of Bessarabia, aroused strong popular anger. In September 1940 General Ion Antonescu forced Carol to abdicate in favour of his son Michael. Carol was allowed to gather all his valuables and ship them out of the country. At the station in Timișoara the Iron Guard fired at the train to kill the king. He escaped and later settled in Portugal. The exiled king died in Estoril, Portugal, in 1953. In 2003 his coffin was brought back to Romania.
